thread:
emma: Dropping a new iteration of the API Keys modal. Focus: make rotate & verify clearer. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/new-keys-ux (frames attached)
raj: Nice cleanup. One big ask: after rotate, show a small "Run smoke test" inline button that executes a prefilled curl and reports success/failure, so people can verify the key works before deleting the old one.
finn: Love the idea. UX question: should the test run automatically open a result pane, or just show a toast/snippet with success/failure and response code? I prefer inline result for context.
claire: Inline result is better for troubleshooting. Keep it minimal: status (200/401), latency, and first 200 chars of response body. Add a 'copy sample request' button next to it.
emma: Accessibility & keyboard: the test button must be reachable via Tab and announce progress via an aria-live region (polite). When results render focus should remain in the modal, not jump.
raj: Copy suggestions: change the post-rotate banner from "Key rotated" to "New key created 3 use it to test integrations. The old key will remain active for 24 hours." (want explicit TTL note).
finn: Also rename 'Regenerate' -> 'Rotate key' across UI to match docs. Small but reduces confusion.
claire: Empty-state note for revoke page: current copy is "Nothing yet". Replace with: "No API keys here. Create a key or connect via OAuth. See key scopes to choose least-privilege." Link 'key scopes' to docs.
emma: Mobile: collapse table rows into stacked cards and move action buttons into a Kebab menu. Ensure touch targets >= 48px.
a11y-bot: Automated scan: warning badge text contrast fails on current palette (3.4:1). Recommend either darken text to #2E1F00 or use bg #FFD39E to hit 4.5:1 for small text. Also confirm focus ring is 3:1 visible against background.
raj: Small security nudge: when a permission sample includes generation rights, show a subtle billing-warning label: "Allows model generation 3 monitor usage" with a link to set alerts.
finn: For the test runner curl snippet, include a ready-to-copy command with --header 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' and a placeholder endpoint. Also include a small note: "This request uses a lightweight model for smoke tests."
emma: Final: when secret is shown after creation, add a bold reminder: "Store this secret now. It won't be displayed again." and a one-click download env file option. Also move focus to the copy button once the secret is revealed.
claire: I'll update the copy and add microcopy variants for the toast and empty state. tagging @raj to mock the test results UI and @finn for the curl formatting.
raj: Will post updated frames today. thanks all :thumbsup:
emma: I'll add the a11y checklist to the PR and include contrast fixes + aria-live guidance.
